page_title: ARS 3-1 SOU | Arsenal v Southampton 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90+7' Half-chance! Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) plays a pass into the box, but Aaron Ramsdale reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+6' Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90+5' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Arsenal have a corner.
90+2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

90+2' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
90+1' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' Here is a change. Riccardo Calafiori is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal).
90' Substitution. Charlie Taylor (Southampton) has come on for Yukinari Sugawara.

89' 3 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 3:1.
87' The game is interrupted now, Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) coming on for Thomas Partey.

83' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
80' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
79' A corner kick by Southampton is thwarted by the well prepared David Raya (Arsenal).

79' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of David Raya. The referee blows his whistle, Southampton are awarded a corner kick.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ryan Manning trots off the pitch and is replaced by Paul Onuachu (Southampton).
74' That will be all from Mateus Fernandes who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Adam Armstrong (Southampton).
72' Tony Harrington sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
70' The Arsenal players halt their celebrations as referee Tony Harrington makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
68' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Bukayo Saka plays it into the box, and Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
67' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
65' Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
64' Wonderful movement by Arsenal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
61' It is time for a substitution. Mikel Merino (Arsenal) is on for Jorginho.
60' Here's the change. Gabriel Jesus leaves the pitch and Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) comes on as a substitute.
60' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) replacing Raheem Sterling.

58' 1 - 1 Bukayo Saka produces a killer pass to release Kai Havertz (Arsenal), who then unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 1:1!
58' 1:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
55' 0 - 1 Cameron Archer (Southampton) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating David Raya with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
54' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
52' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
52' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
50' A rebound falls to Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
49' Wonderful movement by Arsenal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but Aaron Ramsdale intercepts it and averts the threat.
45+2' The corner kick from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Arsenal.
45+2' Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45+2' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Aaron Ramsdale gets down to his right to keep it out.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
43' Ryan Manning (Southampton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tony Harrington stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
41' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. It's a throw-in for Arsenal.

40' Jorginho (Arsenal) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
38' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tony Harrington ignores the protests.
36' Gabriel (Arsenal) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Arsenal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Jan Bednarek (Southampton) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
32' A quickly taken corner by Arsenal.
31' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
31' Arsenal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

30' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
27' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ross Stewart (Southampton) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Cameron Archer.
27' Ross Stewart (Southampton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' The foul by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) was seen by Tony Harrington who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
23' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
23' It's like he was asking for a caution. Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) receives a yellow card.
21' A cross from a corner kick by Arsenal is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
20' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. It will be a corner kick for Arsenal.

20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Arsenal force a corner. They send men into the box.

17' Arsenal slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
15' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.

14' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Arsenal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
12' There's an opportunity for Declan Rice (Arsenal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
12' Aaron Ramsdale leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.

11' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
10' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
8' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a foul and Tony Harrington immediately signals a free kick.
7' Arsenal keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
5' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
4' Arsenal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

3' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Southampton will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Tony Harrington.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
